cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The fundamental principle of the universe, the underlying path of nature, or the ultimate reality.
cards.Nuance (English): In this context, it refers to the ultimate, ineffable essence of existence rather than a path of travel or a method of practice.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): The Way that can be given speech is not the eternal Way. The name that can be named is not the eternal name.
cards.Sentences: S道可道，非常道，名可名，非常名；

cards.Dictionary Meaning (English): The act of expressing something in words or speech.
cards.Nuance (English): Refers specifically to the verbal expression of thoughts or facts.
cards.Sentence Translations (English): This thing cannot be spoken.|Where do you say it is?|He said, 'I must go.'|He spoke his intention.
cards.Sentences: 此道不可言。|君道何在？|彼道其意。|彼道其意。
